author: Koromoro
quote: It’s plot is very boring and slow for the majority of the game and only gets better towards the **** has very good graphics , but 30 fps is way too low for a 13 year wait. Jason is a bland protagonist. Some tasks in the game are straight up dull, like getting groceries . It also costs $80 which I personally don’t think is worth it. It can’t be played on pc , which is the only way to get its abysmal 30 fps any higher.
